text:
Nina Patel: HelixEdge (SI) hit a stop on CardinalLabs private deploy: agent fails on module load and attestation rejects their signed image. Need quick arch sync.
Liam O'Reilly: paste logs?
Nina Patel: `modprobe: ERROR: Invalid module format: accel_drv` and `attestation: unknown signer key id 0x5c2a`.
Juno Park: looks like kmod ABI + signer trust. Which blocks go-live?
Nina Patel: attestation blocks install; accel_drv prevents GPU bind. Both must be addressed.
eng-runtime: we have accel_drv v3.1 built for RHEL8.6 kernels. If their uname matches we can bake a Redwood-signed image as a hotfix.
partner-oncall: HelixEdge CI uses their own signer and can provide the public key fingerprint `5C:2A:11:77:...`. They prefer key onboarding vs re-signing.
eng-security: partner key onboarding is preferred long-term. We'll draft checklist. ETA triage: 6h.
infra-bot: ticket created PARTNER-5100 "HelixEdge key onboarding + accel_drv kmod compat" assigned eng-runtime, eng-security, partner-oncall.
Liam O'Reilly: proposed plan: 1) collect exact uname/k8s labels (Nina) 2) eng-runtime build Redwood-signed image with accel_drv if needed (EOD) 3) eng-security start partner key onboarding (24h) 4) partner-oncall run smoke and confirm.
Juno Park: schedule 30m arch sync tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Invite sent.
Nina Patel: I will upload node metadata and the key fingerprint to PARTNER-5100 now.
eng-runtime: posted test image digest `sha256:deadbeef...` to ticket (do not use in prod until security signs off).
eng-security: will run attestation sim after key onboarding.
Liam O'Reilly: fallback plan: route critical traffic to Redwood Dedicated for up to 72h.
Nina Patel: thanks team — will follow up after the arch sync. :thumbsup:
